test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per the decision by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) of the Government of India in 2023, the MSP for Paddy (Common) has been fixed at _________ higher than the last season.
solution:
The correct answer is __**7%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) of the Government of India fixed the Minimum Support Price (MSP) for Paddy (Common) for the 2023 season to be **0.07** higher than the last season.
 
• The MSP is a form of market intervention by the Government of India to insure agricultural producers against any sharp fall in farm prices.
 
• MSP is announced by the Government at the beginning of the sowing season for certain crops based on the recommendations of the Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP).
 
• This increase is part of the government's efforts to ensure remunerative prices to the growers for their produce.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Minimum Support Price (MSP) system was introduced to safeguard the interests of the farmers.
 
• The MSP is a price fixed by the Government of India to protect the producer - farmers - against excessive fall in price during bumper production years.
 
• The major objectives are to support the farmers from distress sales and to procure food grains for public distribution.
 
• Currently, the MSP covers 23 crops including paddy, wheat, pulses, oilseeds, and some commercial crops.
 
• The MSP is crucial for ensuring food security and managing the agricultural economy.
